sources.title: NetworkIsLife/specter2_base · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SPECTER2 SPECTER2 is the successor to SPECTER and is capable of generating task specific embeddings for scientific tasks when paired with adapters. This is the base model to be used along with the adapters. Given the combination of title and abstract of a scientific paper or a short texual query, the model can be used to generate effective embeddings to be used in downstream applications.
